lead: `[queue]` is a *root* table, so `workers` starts a worker for every `nvs run` over that tree, not just the queue fixture.
body: There is no per-`[[app]]` spelling: `rule:core-classes/queue-storage-is-a-table` makes `workers` a property of the instance, so a worker waiting on an unreachable server charges every unrelated fixture. Grep for a root table's `[[app]]` twin before assuming a block only reaches the program it was written for.
